 Advertisement Updated: 11:54 PM EST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Mike Haddad Chief Meteorologist Video: Sunny stretch into the weekend
 Updated: 11:54 PM EST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Mike Haddad Chief Meteorologist The warm November stretch continues for Thursday and Friday with sunshine and highs near 60 by each afternoon.
 The weekend still looks mild with highs in the upper 50s and mostly sunny conditions. More clouds overall midday Sunday as a coastal low approaches. Showers are possible early Monday as a result of that system.
